newsitem.title: USA: HA-LO, Sharper Image in alliance.
newsitem.headline: HA-LO, Sharper Image in alliance.

text.p: HA-LO Industries Inc said on Tuesday it entered into an alliance with Sharper Image Corp, granting HA-LO the right to develop its own exclusive line of promotional products carrying the Sharper Image name.
Terms of the alliance were not disclosed.

HA-LO said it will develop a catalog of Sharper Image name-brand merchandise to be sold with individual corporate logos. It said Sharper Image will also promote the HA-LO products through its marketing channels.
HA-LO distributes specialty advertising merchandise. Sharper Image is a specialty retailer.
